g.text: G4 Sequence and recovery: one reimbursement claim, end to end
A. The journey runs left to right in five phases; each lane is who acts. Function ids match G3. Built and run live as J1, J5 and J6 (2026-11-06).
Solid arrow: call or data. Dashed: shown to the user.
O1 read each file; C1 check
X1 build the pack, hash h1
B. Recovery: the payer accepted the claim but its answer was lost
Run live as J6 with the mock fault drop_response_after_commit. Result: exactly one claim at the payer (V-10), also after a double click (V-09, V-31).
- the key comes from the approved pack,
so a retry always sends the same key
- the payer returns the same claim
- webhook lost: M1 reads on next open
- a pause survives a browser close or
